---
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE. It is the canonical template; copy it under a new
# filename (kebab-case slug) and edit the copy.
#
# Use  node scripts/new-blog-post.mjs --title "..." --category "..."  to
# scaffold a new post from the CLI; it auto-generates the slug, the OG image
# and writes all fields correctly.
#
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# title: REQUIRED. Raw text only — brand suffix " — Industrial Knives" is
#         appended automatically by Metadata.astro. Aim for 30–40 chars raw
#         so total (raw + 20) lands in the SERP-safe [50, 60] window.
title: 'New Post Title — Short Keyword Phrase'

# excerpt: REQUIRED. Must land in [120, 160] chars. Google truncates at
#           ~155–160; below 120 leaves SERP space empty. State the value
#           proposition plainly (applications, specs, comparison).
excerpt: 'Plain-language summary of the article. Mention the main application, the key spec or comparison axis, and the reader takeaway. Aim for 120–160 characters; the OG image cta will be appended automatically.'

# publishDate: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use today for new posts.
publishDate: 2026-09-27

# category: REQUIRED. Must be one of the existing collection slugs.
#   materials-encyclopedia | glossary | case-studies | selection-guide
#   maintenance | troubleshooting | material-comparison | coatings-comparison | blog
category: 'selection-guide'

# type: REQUIRED. Drives template styling AND JSON-LD schema emission.
#   article    — standard blog post (BlogPosting JSON-LD)
#   glossary   — short reference entries (DefinedTerm JSON-LD)
#   comparison — single-page table / matrix (Table JSON-LD)
type: 'article'

# entityType: optional sub-key for `glossary` (e.g. 'material', 'term').
# comparisonType: optional sub-key for `comparison` (e.g. 'coating', 'material-grade').
# entityType: 'material'
# comparisonType: 'coating'

# tags: optional array of lowercase, kebab-case tags.
tags:
  - 'blade selection'
  - 'material grade'

# author: optional. Defaults to 'Industrial Knives Engineering'.
author: 'Industrial Knives Engineering'

# image: REQUIRED. Auto-populated by scripts/og-image-generator.mjs with the
#         absolute path to /images/og/<slug>.webp. Leave blank on creation;
#         the generator fills it in (or override manually with another asset).
# image: '/images/og/<slug>.webp'

# draft: optional. If true, the URL still emits (category routing) but the
#         product page is excluded from SERP indexing via noindex.
# draft: false

# metadata: optional. description overrides excerpt for SEO. canonical is the
#           absolute URL (no trailing slash). Tags get joined into keywords.
metadata:
  description: 'Plain-language summary of the article. Mention the main application, the key spec or comparison axis, and the reader takeaway. Aim for 120–160 characters.'
  canonical: 'https://www.industrial-knives.net/<category>/<slug>/'
---

# Article body — Markdown only. Start with H1, then H2/H3 subheads.

Replace this section with the article body. Use semantic Markdown — H2 for major sections, H3 for sub-sections, lists for enumerations, fenced code blocks for tabular specs.

## First major section

Body content here. Keep paragraphs short (3–5 sentences). Reference real specs where possible — readers trust concrete numbers more than adjectives.

## Second major section

Continue the article.

## Closing

Wrap up with a clear takeaway. If relevant, add an internal link to a related post or category landing page.
